page.title: Committees
page.description: Six sector committees lead FCC's work, each bringing together member companies to share best practice, discuss industry issues and shape representations.

items.name: Digital Lending Committee
items.description: Works on industry issues, representation and growth of the lending industry in India.
items.who_can_join: Entities in P2P, SME, personal and other lending.

items.name: RegTech Committee
items.description: Works on industry issues, representation and growth of the regulatory technology ecosystem in India.
items.who_can_join: Security, compliance and regulatory technology companies.
items.co_chair_role: Co-Chair · Managing Director, Asia Pacific, Utimaco

items.name: WealthTech Committee
items.description: Works on industry issues, representation and growth of India's investments ecosystem.
items.who_can_join: Investment entities, including personal financial management platforms.

items.name: InsurTech Committee
items.description: Works on industry issues, representation and growth of India's insurance industry.
items.who_can_join: All segments including life, general and health insurance, and aggregators.
items.chair_role: Chair · Joint Group CEO, PB Fintech

items.name: Credit Bureau Committee
items.description: Addresses industry issues through advocacy, with a charter covering financial inclusion, digitisation, prudent lending, compliance and access to information.
items.who_can_join: Credit information companies and the wider credit-data ecosystem.
items.chair_role: Write to us to get involved

items.name: Test Committee
items.description: this is for testing the committee listing
